name: Quiet Precision
purpose: Make operational state and information retrieval legible.
unsuitable: Avoid using a dense table when visitors need a narrative.

recipes.composition: Navigation rail, task toolbar and primary data region.
recipes.grid: Fixed 14rem rail and flexible work area
recipes.typography: Compact sans hierarchy with tabular numbers
recipes.mobile: Rail becomes disclosure; table scrolls within its named region.
recipes.assetStrategy: Prioritize real data and status text; illustrations only explain empty states.

recipes.composition: Horizontal context bar followed by grouped semantic records.
recipes.grid: Single working column with inset summary
recipes.typography: Serif section labels with tabular sans data
recipes.mobile: Records reflow into labeled definition lists.
recipes.assetStrategy: Use factual records and explicit empty cells, not invented activity.

states.loading: Preserve geometry; announce busy region without trapping focus.
states.empty: Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant next action.
states.error: Keep entered values; associate error text and expose retry.
states.success: Announce completion politely without moving focus.
states.focus: Visible 2px outline with offset, never clipped.
states.disabled: Use native disabled where applicable; explain unavailable actions.
states.menu: Native button with aria-expanded; Escape closes and restores trigger focus.

motion: No automatic reordering or animated counters; respect reduced motion.
accessibility: Table headers are associated; keyboard order follows DOM order.
source: Original project-authored recipes; no external assets.
